utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help—thanks, Cleo. Tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll bring a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks — keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it low-key. And thanks again, Cleo, for checking our repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort the donated parts and label the boxes so we can keep everything organized?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help sort the parts and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’m still sorting what’s left — I’ll let you know the next step as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear — I’m glad people are pitching in. If you want, I can help sort the donations or keep an eye out for anything we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Jules — if you can keep an eye out for what we’re still missing, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I’m keeping it low-key. I’m checking the school schedule now, and then I can share what we’ve got so far.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help with whatever’s left once you’ve got the schedule sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning. Seems like the whole block’s pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye out for where the repair drive is set up and let you know if I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — please let me know the exact spot once you find it, so I can plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need to sort the remaining tasks for the repair drive. I can help if you want to point me to what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think there’s still a pile of sorting to do, but I’m a bit behind on what’s already been handled.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get neighbors involved. If you want, I can also help line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Quinn—that would be a big help. We’re set for Sunday at the community center now, and we still need a few volunteers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bo, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s staying low-key for now, and I’ll let folks know you can help a little with the repair drive.
